One of the biggest speed bumps to wider electric-car adoption is the challenge of where to recharge. Tesla has been blanketing the country with its Superchargers since its early days in 2012, and now operates about half of all fast-charging plugs in the United States. results.content:
That first Roadster showed a practical, long-distance battery-electric car was not just possible, but could equal or surpass gasoline cars. When the Tesla Model S arrived six years later, the world sat up and paid attention. Within a decade, Tesla had catapulted into the ranks of global automakers. [...] Courtesy Tesla

I got my first ride in a Tesla in September 2006. Two months before, an unknown electric-car startup in Silicon Valley, named after Serbian inventor Nikola Tesla, had come out of stealth mode. Its Southern California debut on July 19, limited to 350 people, was mostly covered by the tech press. None of my car friends had ever heard of it.
